privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.notice: Placeholder text. This page needs legal review before launch.

blocks.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: When you submit a project brief or a job application we collect the details you give us: your name, email address, company, budget range, timeline and message. We do not collect special-category data and we do not ask for payment details through this site.

blocks.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use it to reply to you and, if we work together, to deliver the engagement. We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.

blocks.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: We measure aggregate traffic to understand which pages are useful. No individual visitor is identified from analytics data.

blocks.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Project briefs are kept for two years. Job applications are kept for twelve months unless you ask us to delete them sooner.

blocks.heading: Your rights
bullets: Ask for a copy of the data we hold about you
Ask us to correct anything inaccurate
Object to how we are using it

blocks.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For anything on this page, write to us at the address below.
